title: Closed-Loop PID Autotuner
text: Automatically tune PID gains based on plant frequency responses estimated from closed-loop experiment in real time, 7 inputs, 7 outputs, {Experiment Mode} sets Perturbation signal type; {Type} sets the pID controller actions, {Form} sets the pID controller form, {Time Domain} sets the pID controller time, {Controller sample time (sec)} sets the sample time of PID controller, {Tune at different sample time} enables tuning at different sample time from PID controller, {Tuning sample time (sec)} sets the sample time of tuning algorithm, {Experiment sample time (sec)} sets the sample time for experiment, {Integrator method} sets the discrete integration formula for integrator term Forward, {Filter method} sets the discrete integration formula for derivative filter term Forward, {Target bandwidth (rad/sec)} sets the target crossover frequency of tuned, {Target phase margin (degrees)} sets the target minimum phase margin of open-loop, {Plant Type} sets the stability of plant, {Plant Sign} sets the sign of plant, {Signal Amplitudes} sets the amplitude of perturbations, {Reduce memory and avoid task overrun (external mode only)} sets the deploy tuning algorithm only, {Configure block for PLC Coder} sets the configure block for code generation with Simulink PLC, {Output Signal Configuration} sets the provide control signal plus perturbation or perturbation only control action +, {Data Type} sets the floating point precision, {Clicking "Update PID Block" writes tuned gains to the PID block connected to "u" port} sets the automatically detect target for writing tuned PID, {Specify PID block path} sets the target PID controller block for writing tuned coefficients, {Update PID Block} sets the write tuned PID gains to target controller block and {Export to MATLAB} sets the send experiment and tuning results to MATLAB ® workspace. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Type
params.values: PID controller actions PI (default) | PID | PIDF |...

params.name: Form
params.values: PID controller form Parallel (default) | Ideal

params.name: Time Domain
params.values: PID controller time domain discrete-time (default) | continuous-time

params.name: Controller sample time (sec)
params.values: Sample time of PID controller 0.1 (default) | positive scalar | –1

params.name: Tune at different sample time
params.values: Enable tuning at different sample time from PID controller and experiment off (default) | on

params.name: Tuning sample time (sec)
params.values: Sample time of tuning algorithm 0.2 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Experiment sample time (sec)
params.values: Sample time for experiment 0.02 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Integrator method
params.values: Discrete integration formula for integrator term Forward Euler (default) | Backward Euler | Trapezoidal

params.name: Filter method
params.values: Discrete integration formula for derivative filter term Forward Euler (default) | Backward Euler | Trapezoidal

params.name: Target bandwidth (rad/sec)
params.values: Target crossover frequency of tuned response 1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Target phase margin (degrees)
params.values: Target minimum phase margin of open-loop response 60 (default) | scalar in range 0–90

params.name: Experiment Mode
params.values: Perturbation signal type Superposition (default) | Sinestream | PRBS (since R2023b)

params.name: Plant Type

params.name: Plant Sign

params.name: Signal Amplitudes
